Which statement about solid magnesium oxide is correct?
A
It is a giant structure made up of magnesium and oxygen atoms bonded covalently.
B
It is an electrical conductor with mobile magnesium ions and oxygen ions.
C
Magnesium loses electrons and these electrons move freely through a lattice.
D
Oxygen ions and magnesium ions are attracted to each other in a giant lattice.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a giant structure made up of magnesium and oxygen atoms bonded covalently.

options.label: B
options.text: It is an electrical conductor with mobile magnesium ions and oxygen ions.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnesium loses electrons and these electrons move freely through a lattice.

options.label: D
options.text: Oxygen ions and magnesium ions are attracted to each other in a giant lattice.
